run_eval_concap_retrieval: run image-caption retrieval evaluation on COCO dataset using a pretrained multimodal BERT model
evaluate_retrieval_metrics: evaluate retrieval performance and compute recall@1, recall@5, recall@10, median rank, and mean rank
load_conceptcap_dataset: load ConceptCapLoaderRetrieval dataset with image features from HDF5 and captions from JSONL for retrieval evaluation
build_multimodal_bert_model: build a BertForMultiModalPreTraining model from pretrained weights for image-caption retrieval tasks
save_evaluation_results: save evaluation metrics including r1, r5, r10, medr, and meanr to a result file in the output directory
